  CALL %(proc_prefix)sCLEAR_CACHES()

C MadLoop jumps to this label during stability checks when it recomputes a rotated PS point
200 CONTINUE
C For the computation of a rotated version of this PS point we must reset the all MadLoop cache since this changes the definition of the loop denominators.
C We don't check for AUTOMATIC_CACHE_CLEARING here because the Lorentz test should anyway be disabled if the flag is turned off.
CALL %(proc_prefix)sCLEAR_CACHES()

## if(AmplitudeReduction) {
  IF(SKIPLOOPEVAL.OR.(.NOT.LOOP_REQ_SO_DONE.AND..NOT.MP_LOOP_REQ_SO_DONE)) THEN
    GOTO 5000
  ENDIF
  DO I=1,NSQUAREDSO
    DO J=1,NLOOPGROUPS
      S(I,J)=.TRUE.
    ENDDO
  ENDDO
C We need the dummy argument I_SO for the squared order index to conform to the structure that the call to the LOOP* subroutine takes for processes with Born diagrams.
  I_SO=1
%(loop_CT_calls)s

## if(not AmplitudeReduction){
DO I_SO=1,NSQUAREDSO
  DO J=1,NLOOPGROUPS
    S(I_SO,J)=.TRUE.
  ENDDO
  IF (FILTER_SO.and.SQSO_TARGET.NE.I_SO) GOTO 5001
%(loop_CT_calls)s
  GOTO 5001
5000 CONTINUE
  CTCALL_REQ_SO_DONE=.TRUE.
5001 CONTINUE
ENDDO

        # conditions more readable in the include files.
        AmplitudeReduction = LoopInduced or ComputeColorFlows

		TIR_CACHE_INDEX = MOD(TIR_CACHE_INDEX-1,MAX(TIR_CACHE_SIZE,1))+1

## }

	    IF(TIR_CACHE_INDEX.NE.0) THEN

	        ENDDO
	      ENDDO

	    ENDIF
	  ELSE
	    DO I=1,3
	      DO J=0,NLOOPCOEFS-1
	        TIRCOEFS(J,I)=TIRCOEFS_CACHING(I,J,I_LOOPGROUP,TIR_CACHE_INDEX)
	      ENDDO
	    ENDDO
	  ENDIF
## }
      DO I=1,3
	     RES(I)=(0.0d0,0.0d0)
      	 DO J=0,NLOOPCOEFS-1
## if(not AmplitudeReduction){
	       RES(I)=RES(I)+LOOPCOEFS(J,I_SQSO,I_LOOPGROUP)*TIRCOEFS(J,I)
## }else{
	       RES(I)=RES(I)+LOOPCOEFS(J,I_LOOPGROUP)*TIRCOEFS(J,I)

	 ENDDO

SCALE=MU_R**2
      NC=NCOEF_R(RANK)
      CACHE_ENABLED=TIRustGlobalCache.EQ.-1.OR.NLOOPLINE.LE.TIRustGlobalCache
      CHECK_PASS=CTMODE.EQ.2.OR.CTMODE.EQ.5

SUBROUTINE %(proc_prefix)sINITIALIZE_TIRUST(STATUS)
      USE MTIRUST
      IMPLICIT NONE
      INTEGER STATUS
      INTEGER LAST_GENERATION
      COMMON/%(proc_prefix)sTIRUST_INIT/LAST_GENERATION
      STATUS=TIRUST_SUCCESS
      IF(LAST_GENERATION.EQ.TIRUST_CONTEXT_GENERATION()) RETURN
      %(tirust_plan_registration)s
      LAST_GENERATION=TIRUST_CONTEXT_GENERATION()

## if(tirust_supports_quad_prec){
      ELSEIF(MLReductionLib(I_LIB).EQ.9.AND.DOING_QP) THEN
        CALL %(proc_prefix)sMP_TIRUST_LOOP(NLOOPLINE,MP_PL,M2L,RANK,LOOPRES(1,SQUAREDSOINDEX,LOOPNUM),S(SQUAREDSOINDEX,LOOPNUM))
## }
      ELSE
C Tensor Integral Reduction is used 
	CALL %(proc_prefix)sTIRLOOP(SQUAREDSOINDEX,LOOPNUM,I_LIB,NLOOPLINE,PL,M2L,RANK,LOOPRES(1,SQUAREDSOINDEX,LOOPNUM),S(SQUAREDSOINDEX,LOOPNUM))

subroutine tirust_clear_cache(status)
    integer, intent(out), optional :: status
    integer :: result
    call ensure_context(result)
    if (result == TIRUST_SUCCESS) result = clear_cache(context)
    if (present(status)) status = result
  end subroutine

  subroutine tirust_register_plan(n,rank,status)
    integer, intent(in) :: n,rank
    integer, intent(out) :: status
    call ensure_context(status)
    if (status == TIRUST_SUCCESS) status = register_plan(context,int(n,c_int),int(rank,c_int))

allocate(p_text(record_size,4*n),s_text(record_size,n*n),m_text(record_size,2*n), &
             output(record_size,8*count),values(8*count),stat=ios)
    if (ios /= 0) return
    local_error = 'TIRust could not encode a finite binary128 input.'
    do i=1,n
      call pack(real(masses(i),kind=KI_QTIR),m_text(:,2*i-1),ios)
      if (ios /= 0) return
      call pack(aimag(masses(i)),m_text(:,2*i),ios)
      if (ios /= 0) return
      do j=0,3
        call pack(shifts(j,i),p_text(:,4*(i-1)+j+1),ios)
        if (ios /= 0) return
      enddo
      do j=1,n
        call pack(invariants(j,i),s_text(:,n*(i-1)+j),ios)
        if (ios /= 0) return
      enddo
    enddo
    call pack(mu2,scale_text,ios)
    if (ios /= 0) return
    call options(pole_mode,compute_finite,check_pass,cache_enabled,poles,finite,check,cache)
    call ensure_context(status)
    if (status /= TIRUST_SUCCESS) return
    status = evaluate_mp(context,int(n,c_int),int(rank,c_int),p_text,size(p_text,kind=c_size_t), &
                         s_text,size(s_text,kind=c_size_t),m_text,size(m_text,kind=c_size_t), &
                         scale_text,size(scale_text,kind=c_size_t),output,size(output,kind=c_size_t), &
                         poles,finite,check,cache)
